nodes.label: Unity client
nodes.description: Renders received match state and sends input through composition-root services.

nodes.label: GameServer
nodes.description: Authoritative simulation owns movement, collision, HP, zone, lifecycle and result; rooms have isolated runtimes.

nodes.label: ASP.NET Core API
nodes.description: Owns account JWT, tickets, room account permissions, history and authoritative-result persistence.

nodes.label: MongoDB
nodes.description: Persists users, legacy Guest and immutable match results; no tick dependency.

nodes.label: Persistent match-result outbox
nodes.description: Outside-tick queue writes volume-backed results and retries API delivery; failures must be reported.

nodes.label: Backend/GameServer/Simulation
nodes.description: Pure C# fixed 30 Hz simulation; application loop is single writer.

nodes.label: Backend/GameServer/Networking
nodes.description: LiteNetLib / WebSocket adapters own handshake/session/resume/packets, not game rules.

nodes.label: Backend/GameServer/Rooms
nodes.description: Room data is changed through commands queued to application loop.

nodes.label: Backend/Shared/Protocol
nodes.description: Shared binary schema and serializers, separate from transport ownership.

nodes.label: Backend/Shared/GameData
nodes.description: Versioned authoritative maps, match rules and zone schedule.

nodes.label: StreamingAssets/JungleMaze/runtime
nodes.description: Sync Runtime Data copies offline maps/rules and SHA256 manifest; stale builds rejected.

nodes.label: SessionHub
nodes.description: Owns session-sensitive game transport and eliminated-player replay authorization.

nodes.label: RoomManager
nodes.description: GameServer room manager participates in session and room topology.

nodes.label: Backend/Shared/GameData/Maps
nodes.description: Published map catalog; external MAP_DATA_PATH overrides image data.

nodes.label: MapPublisher
nodes.description: Validates catalog package, preserves payload ID/hash, saves old manifest and atomically switches catalog.

nodes.label: Published authored maps: Di tích cổ and Bãi đá
nodes.description: Separate layouts share rules; each room owns its MapDefinition and active match retains its snapshot.

nodes.label: MapId + MapHash
nodes.description: Identifies immutable source map; combined with RulesHash in match result/history.

nodes.label: RulesHash
nodes.description: Independent rules identity includes versioned airdrop schedule; source map hash is unchanged by dynamic drops.

nodes.label: Session host authority
nodes.description: Session host chooses map and starts after verified clients; distinct from account room owner.

nodes.label: Gameplay protocol v4
nodes.description: Preserves room map/start and bot metadata contracts; adds authoritative airdrop state and resync baseline. Old clients receive GameplayVersionMismatch.

nodes.label: Account play ticket handshake v4
nodes.description: One-use 256-bit ticket with 30 s TTL binds account, attempt and room; gameplay version is separate; JWT is not sent over UDP.

nodes.label: Account JWT
nodes.description: Account API authentication; ownership from verified sub claim; long-term credentials use HTTPS remotely.

nodes.label: Legacy Guest history
nodes.description: Retains old history but cannot obtain new game tickets or manage rooms; no nickname-based merging.

nodes.label: Auto UDP to WSS fallback
nodes.description: UDP up to 5 s, then WS connect up to 10 s and join up to 5 s; one pre-application-message switch, same attempt/ticket and slot. No route switch after join.

nodes.label: Caddy
nodes.description: Public TLS reverse proxy routes exactly /game to game-server:7781 and API to api:5000; blocks internal routes.

nodes.label: Room match lifecycle
nodes.description: Waiting → Lobby → Loading → InGame → Ending → Cleanup → Waiting; main min6/max10, countdown5 s, loading30 s, ending10 s.

nodes.label: Session resume proof and grace
nodes.description: 15 s grace keeps stationary damageable avatar and slot; fresh account ticket plus rotating resume proof restores same player.

nodes.label: OfflineMatchSession
nodes.description: Unity-only practice: no socket, HTTP, Docker, API result or outbox; solo survives until zone elimination.

nodes.label: OfflineWorldSession
nodes.description: Offline world owns pure-C# airdrop runtime/controller while practicing.

nodes.label: HealthService
nodes.description: Shared authoritative damage service; zone bypasses armor and applies at most once per tick.

nodes.label: Safe Zone
nodes.description: Server chooses seeded nested reachable zones and publishes current/next centers and shrink ticks; outside damage5 HP/s.

nodes.label: Session-authorized killcam replay
nodes.description: Replay packet v1, victim-only request after elimination; victim+killer up to150 frames,75 per chunk,<4KiB,3 requests/player/match.

nodes.label: Server-authoritative bot FSM
nodes.description: Per-bot memory/seed in RAM; 5 Hz staggered perception and decision, 30 Hz shared movement/combat; no fake account/socket/JWT.

nodes.label: Backend/Shared/GameData/bot_settings.json
nodes.description: Owns server bot configuration including soft global path budget.

nodes.label: Resumable A-star shared path budget
nodes.description: 0.5-cell grid,500 nodes/request,1500 nodes/tick globally, soft4 ms budget; endpoint/frontier work resumes fairly across rooms.

nodes.label: WithBots result metadata
nodes.description: Bot participant has IsBot and no ProfileKey; human history records WithBots separately from HumanOnly.

nodes.label: Configured room and slot limits
nodes.description: 10 participants/room,5 rooms,50 active/pending/grace/bot slots; not a50-human gameplay performance guarantee.

nodes.label: MatchAudioEventSource
nodes.description: Online/offline real combat and pose/terrain audio; predicted shots are not repeated by confirmation.

nodes.label: Bounded tick-stage, GC and loop-gap diagnostics
nodes.description: Reports dropped ticks and fixed catch-up limit alongside stage timing/GC/CPU/loop gaps; does not hide stalls.

nodes.label: Linux AMD64 ReadyToRun publish
nodes.description: Reduces first-use JIT; not a guarantee of zero stall.

nodes.label: NetSmokeClient
nodes.description: Protocol/backend gameplay flow smoke, map ack and host Start; not Unity gameplay acceptance.

nodes.label: GHCR private
nodes.description: Separate publish/read package credentials; digest-pinned API/GameServer images.

nodes.label: deploy-aws.ps1 / registry deployment
nodes.description: PrepareOnly, Deploy, Rollback; deployment requires clean commit and never auto commits/pushes or starts/stops EC2.

nodes.label: Private deployment-status app-queue snapshot
nodes.description: Existing control secret protects queued read-only snapshot; human/session/bot/entity activity or non-Waiting match blocks GameServer change.

nodes.label: flock + transient systemd rollback guard
nodes.description: Owns pull/switch/PC-check/accept-or-rollback even after PC/SSH disconnect.

nodes.label: PC Quick / Full acceptance
nodes.description: API-only can use Quick; server/protocol/rules/shared contract requires Full, including WSS1+9/300 s, Auto2, history/replay and real UDP.

nodes.label: KeepInstanceRunning policy
nodes.description: Explicitly allocated keep-running windows use no Stop timer; deadline closes clients/tools and EC2 remains billable.

nodes.label: Documented acceptance and capacity limits
nodes.source_location: Chọn map theo phòng; Bot trong phòng mạng; §7–10; DRG-01
nodes.description: Architecture text and deploy presence do not establish runtime PASS. Multiple Unity processes do not replace two physical PCs;50 participants tested only Local, not50 WAN players. Invalid generators/PC sleep require INVALID. DRG-01 AWS deployment has not occurred in this Local acceptance round.

nodes.label: DRG-01 — Rồng thả trứng
nodes.description: Documented dragon egg airdrop feature with authoritative online and offline runtime; acceptance evidence is delegated to its report.

nodes.label: airdrop_schedule.json
nodes.description: Versioned rule synchronized to Unity and included in RulesHash.

nodes.label: AirdropRuntime / AirdropController
nodes.description: Pure C# at GameServer online and OfflineWorldSession offline; per-match state, seed and ID.

nodes.label: Airdrop lifecycle
nodes.description: Scheduled → Flying → Falling → Landed → Broken, or Cancelled; Supply/collision/HP registers only after landing.

nodes.label: Bounded reachable landing selection
nodes.description: Cached reachable cells are filtered by forecast landing-time zone; tries at most64 footprints and retries each second for up to5 seconds; never forces overlaps.
nodes.rationale: Bounded work and refusal to overlap protect tick work and valid landing geometry.

nodes.label: Reliable AirdropStatePacket over UDP / WS
nodes.description: MatchId,DropId,revision,flight path,tick milestones,size/HP and world ID; invalid match or old revision is discarded.

nodes.label: Airdrop resync baseline
nodes.description: Reconstructs visuals without replaying old sounds; world pages synchronize HP,breakage and loot.

nodes.label: Match-local dynamic Supply / loot reservation
nodes.description: Reserves3 egg slots and24 loot stacks; room runtimes are isolated. Egg is retained if capacity preflight fails.
nodes.scope: per-match; per-room runtime isolation is stated in §1

nodes.label: DestructibleService
nodes.description: Confirms hit and checks available capacity before lethal strike; cannot destroy egg and lose its loot.

nodes.label: Supply loot and shared pickup
nodes.description: 6–8 distinct loot kinds always include MACE/COMPASS; guns retain ammo in stack so separate AMMO cannot exceed8 stacks. F picks up dropped loot, not open eggs.

nodes.label: Public-marker bot airdrop goal
nodes.description: Bots contest public airdrop markers below danger/zone/retreat/combat priorities; break/pick up through shared combat/inventory and cannot create loot.

nodes.label: AirdropVisualSet / prefab
nodes.description: Uses existing dragon/egg art; manifest records provenance and hearing/verification status.

nodes.label: WorldSceneView airdrop presentation
nodes.description: Owns dragon,shadow,fall/break egg,HP and minimap marker renderers; visuals neither randomize position nor deal damage; cleanup on leave/replay.

nodes.label: DragonRoar / EggLand / EggBreak audio ownership
nodes.description: DragonRoar is global; EggLand and EggBreak are spatial; baseline restore does not replay old sounds.

nodes.label: Docs/Reports/DRG01/report.vi.md reference
nodes.description: Architecture refers to this report for technical results and limitations; report contents were not read in this extraction.
